annotation.title_en: Rules of Procedure of the Parliament Meetings B.E. 2563 (2020), as amended (No. 2) B.E. 2568 (2025)
annotation.summary_en: Thai Parliament's Rules of Procedure for joint sittings (2020), as amended by Amendment No. 2 (2025). It covers the powers of the presiding officer, meeting procedures, motions, debate, voting, committees, bills and treaty approval. Despite the collector's title about Gen AI, the content is unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines duties and powers of the Parliament President and Secretary-General
Sets procedures for convening, agenda, quorum, debate and voting
Amendment No. 2 (2025) allows electronic notice of meetings and agendas
Governs organic bills, treaty approval, policy statements and general debates
Interpretation of the rules is decided by Parliament; amendments need 40 members' endorsement
